how_to_add: Add an event or a year in this file only. No template change. One events object is one edition: slug, series (every year of that show uses the same series and the same name), name, year, past_name, start, end, timezone, url, source_url, source_note. On the company, add one history entry per edition: event (the edition slug), year, source (http or https URL of the exhibitor list for that year). source is required. CI rejects a missing, blank, or non-URL source. On and before the end date, in that timezone, the year stays highlighted: Exhibiting at {name} · {dates}. Years of the same series that have already ended share one line, most recent first: Exhibited at EP Shanghai 2026 · 2025. A show with one past year reads Exhibited at WETEX 2025. The next calendar day after the end date, the highlighted year joins that line. Sourced editions in this file are EP Shanghai 2026, Enlit Europe 2026, ADIPEC 2026, ENERGETICS 2026, ELECRAMA 2025, CIGRE GCC Power 2025, WETEX 2025, and Vietnam Energy Week 2025. Do not add a year that has no exhibitor list.

events.name: EP Shanghai
events.source_note: Official visiting information lists the exhibition as 3–5 December 2026 at the Shanghai New International Expo Center. Opening hours are 09:00–16:30 on 3 and 4 December 2026 and 09:00–15:00 on 5 December 2026. The badge stays highlighted through the end date in Asia/Shanghai. Each company history entry cites the official exhibitor-list page. The names themselves come from the partial exhibitor-list PDF dated 2026-08-31. No earlier year is listed because this file has no exhibitor list for one.
